question: Is the inverse-diameter RMS law implied by independent two-dimensional P4BC measurement cells compatible with the existing measured 13/27/57-micrometre granularity tables?

branch_rule.pass: Retain independent-cell aperture scaling as cross-material compatibility only; it still does not identify Kodak spatial NPS.
branch_rule.fail: Close independent-cell spatial/raster interpretation; retain P4BC only as a deterministic cell-statistics reference and require a materially different correlated spatial mechanism plus fresh evidence.

forbidden: fit or substitute the observed exponent after scoring
change aperture roles, omit hard rows or impute missing values
treat radiographic film/process/scanner tables as Kodak 250D calibration
render photographs or alter product defaults
claim_ceiling: No-fit cross-material compatibility of the independent-cell inverse-diameter aperture law against public radiographic-film granularity tables; not Kodak, stock, process, scanner, microscopic geometry, NPS calibration or product evidence.
